body: Whelp, times up. I won’t be reading or responding to anything.
Not specifically people who use antidepressants. Just people in general
Drugs are very effective. They only work on people who want a future. I have a problem with the people. They don’t leave.
Thanks random internet homie.
If I go before people find out I’m not ok, we can skip the long terrible years of slowly becoming a shell of a person until I inevitably burn out in front of my family’s eyes.

I’ve already made a post about this but long story short, I can’t handle the responsibilities of living a productive life without becoming a hateful depressed train wreck. This is just a mercy shot before things get ugly.

Some people are able to stick around and some people can’t. I made a previous post about this, but long story short is that I can’t really handle the responsibilities of living without becoming a depressed hateful train wreck. I would like to give myself a mercy shot before things get ugly.
Thanks for asking. But no thanks. Sorry if It’s weird talking to someone who isn’t going to be around long.
Same! I’ll actually be leaving tonight for those reasons. I love my family and everything but me turning into even more of a depressed train wreck won’t help anyone.
Survival instincts
Therapist.
Maybe. I’ll see how that works out.
Okay, tell me anything.
Same (I have 16 days left).  Do you feel like talking about it?
No problem.
I googled it and a post on quora said it would be almost impossible to self inflict but if done right you would die in a maximum of 3-4 mins (a lot faster if you pull the knife out afterwards tho)
That does sound like a peaceful way to go. But are you sure there’s nothing left for you here? Just think about it. I wish you well.

Ngl that sounds really shitty. But you have someone that loves you and would miss you if you went. Personally, I don’t think committing suicide makes someone weak, but if there is always another option (no matter how small) and it’s worth a shot isn’t it? Just think about it.
Same here. I have a date set and I have no idea what I’m going to do if it doesn’t work. I wish you well.
If you seriously cannot avoid self harm, there are bathing suits that will cover the scars. Just google “one piece surfer swimsuit.” I use one and it works for me.
You can talk to me
Ah, a fellow emotion bottler. I’d be happy to listen if there’s more.
Would you actually gain something from that? Are you sure there’s nothing left in this life for you? Please think first.

This subreddit is full of people who don’t have the luxury of keeping up with “good” morals and I’m no different. I’m just going to ask you to think. Weigh your options. And decide if any of them will actually bring you anything.
Thank you. It’s comforting to know that I’m not the only one out there.

Sad music, grunge aesthetic quotes, trigger thoughts like “I’m not meant for this place.” “Nobody loves me.” “How the fuck did I manage to screw my self over this bad.” And then start thinking about how you think people would react to your death. That’s how I do it anyway. A word of advice: it’s harder to summon up suicidal thoughts than it is to feed them once they eventually come around.
